question: How could GA and Streeling rehearse an agent or tool substitution while preserving source-bound review and publication evidence, without assuming a future model is better?
production_path: investigation: read pinned GA harness methodology and Streeling source-bound review triage
contract sketch: define source identity, checks, human verdict, and public readback as stage outputs
simulation: compare four imaginary adapters on the same three cases using hard gates
adversarial: reject faster cases with source drift, missing readback, or pending review
test: deterministic fixture rerun, five answered exercises, and explicit real-trial falsifier
hypothesis: A future agent replacement is worth a bounded trial only when it can preserve auditable stage evidence and improve accepted outcomes after setup and correction costs, rather than increasing draft speed alone.
evidence: GA docs/methodology/agentic-engineering.md at dc2e74cbd992a298f67efb928b5b3754615e1924 describes harness quality, clear seams, bounded queues, and efficient human review; these are project design principles, not measured agent interchangeability.

Demerzel scripts/streeling_review_candidates.py at 74d425dcd2ad92b4712160e3f5df7b2472c12b97 indexes exact Git source blobs for triage and explicitly does not authenticate a human verdict. Learn PR #170 is draft exact-source receipt work, not a deployed production guarantee.

Synthetic fixture at 789239053dfeca9f044d2f893a3f277cb4ed9d8d evaluates three identical labeled cases per adapter: current and portable pass 3/3 with median fixture times 40 and 32 minutes and two corrections each; fast passes 1/3 because of source drift and missing public-readback check; shortcut passes 0/3 because all review labels are pending. These labels are not real Git identities, human verdicts, or network fetches.

A byte-identical evaluator rerun and course preflight check the fixture and five answered exercises. No actual alternate-agent run, authenticated human subject or learner review, localization, production switch, or public page readback was measured. Research duration was not instrumented; duration_seconds=0 records that limitation.
